verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's files-and-results docs list supported file types, including CSV, JSON, YAML, source code and Jupyter notebooks. Files can be sent into a chat via the mobile share sheet, and Bots keep their files on a persistent cloud computer with a filesystem. However, the evidence covers only structured and text formats, not office documents or PDFs, and nothing shows analysis accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit PDF and Word/Excel document support, documented analysis capabilities, independent or hands-on evidence of accurate file analysis.
